_about: Furniture for the sandbox in the new look: tables to replace the plain boxes, a stone plinth, a cold campfire and a chunkier training dummy.

subjects.subject: A long sturdy rustic wooden trestle table, a thick plank top on two solid A-shaped trestle legs with a stretcher beam, iron nails, empty top with nothing on it, chunky solid shapes.
A waist-high square stone pedestal made of three stacked chunky carved stone blocks with a leaf pattern band and a little moss at the base, flat empty top, solid simple shape.
A cold dead campfire with no fire at all: a ring of chunky grey stones around a small pile of thick charred black logs and grey ash, no flames, no embers, no glow, no smoke, solid simple shapes.

A combat training dummy: a thick wooden post on a heavy cross base, a fat round straw-stuffed burlap sack body tied with rope, a smaller burlap sack head, a round red and white painted target on the chest, a dented iron pot helmet, two short thick wooden arm stubs, chunky solid shapes, no face.
